As the Account Manager, you are a licensed producer working alongside your squad's Account Executive. It's a hands-on role for a producer who wants to sell, learn fast and grow toward running a squad.

Cover for your Account Executive so clients always reach a licensed advisor, and bring material coverage, eligibility or strategy changes back to the AE

sections.title: Operating Principles
paras: Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:
We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.
bullets: Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.
Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.
Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.
Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

sections.title: AI-First by Default
paras: We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.
That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.
bullets: Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.
Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.
Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.
Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

sections.title: Why Harvey
paras: At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Majors Customer Success Manager, you’ll lead AI implementation, adoption and change management for Harvey’s largest customers, including leading law firms, Fortune 500 companies and asset managers. You’ll work directly with senior leaders and practicing lawyers to identify where AI can improve their work, turn those opportunities into implementation plans and lead the cross-functional effort to deliver results.

You’ll own the customer relationship end to end as the primary lead for a portfolio of strategic accounts, from initial deployment through ongoing adoption and renewal. This role combines the strategic depth of advisory work with responsibility for account health, measurable customer value and retention. You’ll drive retention by establishing measurable value, understanding customer needs and addressing barriers to continued investment, partnering with Sales throughout the customer lifecycle.

What You’ll Do
bullets: Lead implementation and transformation programs. Assess customer goals and current workflows, identify valuable use cases and build plans with clear milestones, owners and success measures. Drive execution across practice groups, business functions and regions, adapting the plan as you learn what works.

Drive change in how lawyers work. Partner with lawyers and customer leadership to embed Harvey into everyday practice. Develop champions, address resistance and coordinate targeted training with Legal Product Specialists. Help customers turn successful individual use cases into repeatable ways of working across teams.

Own your customer portfolio. Set account strategy and use adoption data, stakeholder feedback and business impact to assess progress and direct the next phase of work. Address risks early and lead the response to escalations, keeping customers informed and internal teams accountable for resolution.

Advise executives and align stakeholders. Build relationships with senior partners, General Counsel and innovation, technology and operations leaders. Lead discussions about investment and progress, align stakeholders with competing goals and manage difficult conversations when expectations or results shift.

sections.title: About Method
paras: Method is on a mission to transform how small businesses operate by giving them real control over their customer workflows.

Our flagship product, Method CRM, is purpose-built for small businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets and generic tools. With deep QuickBooks and Xero integrations and a powerful no-code customization engine, Method lets users design workflows that truly fit their unique needs.

sections.title: The Role

Oversee the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and definition to launch and continuous improvement, so that nothing ships without a clear link to a validated customer problem.
Conduct market research and competitive analysis to inform product positioning and ensure our platform remains a market leader.
Run and improve our established product processes, replacing manual approvals with AI agents that decide and notify the person who used to sign off, while holding our quality bar.
Track and improve the key performance indicators (KPIs) that measure product success, judged by customer outcomes rather than output or appearances.
Align with Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Customer Support before building, not after shipping, so every launch is one the go-to-market team understands and can sell.

ashby:partly.com:27cdd141-0367-4666-8515.summary: Note: Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.

sections.title: 🚀 Our Story
paras: Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.

Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify), with Blackbird Ventures, WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree and Ecliptic Venture Capital. Hear it from the team: Why Partly exists and AI at Partly .

You will own the customer relationship end to end: setting up pilots, measuring what changes, and building the evidence that wins the workflow. You'll be the person the customer calls, and the person who brings their reality back to our Product team.

Why join now: Partly closed a $50M Series B led by DST Global and is scaling fast across the US, UK and Australasia, in a $1.9 trillion industry that modern software has barely touched. You'd be early, close to the founders, and given real ownership from day one.

Prove the value. Agree success measures with the customer, track them weekly, and report results in terms claims leaders care about: cycle time, accuracy and cost.
Own the relationship day to day. Be the trusted contact for users of the product.
Resolve issues to ground. Work directly with Product and Engineering on data, integration and workflow problems until they're fixed.
Convert and expand. Build the case for moving from pilot to programme, and spot where the account can grow.
Bring the insurer's voice inside. Turn what you see in claims workflows into clear input for Product and our business development team.

Know the claims workflow, from first notice of loss to repair or total loss, including estimating and parts decisions.

ashby:render:d0860ea9-fdbd-4a66-82bc-1d7.summary:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Render's datastores, anchored on Postgres. Your scope spans provisioning and lifecycle management, high availability and disaster recovery, backups and point-in-time recovery, scaling and performance, connection management, and the extension ecosystem.

Drive prioritization across Render's data investments, balancing the leverage of foundational reliability work — replication, failover, storage performance — against near-term product and business needs, and being able to negotiate those tradeoffs.

Partner deeply with Engineering & other Product teams to shape the technical direction of Render's data layer, ensuring architectural decisions optimize for durability, performance, and operational simplicity. Databases are where customer trust is won or lost, so an instinct for reliability and data safety is essential.

Develop a strong, opinionated point of view on how managed Postgres needs to evolve to serve AI-native builders — from vector workloads and retrieval pipelines to databases that are spun up, branched, and torn down programmatically by agents at scale.

Set the standard for how developers experience data on Render, providing clear guidance, sensible defaults, and abstractions that make it easy for teams to run production databases with confidence — without needing a DBA on staff.

sections.title: We're looking for
bullets: 7+ years in Product Management, with the majority spent on databases, data infrastructure, developer tools, or platform products.

Familiarity with Postgres — its architecture, operational model, ecosystem, and the tradeoffs teams face running it in production. Bonus if you have strong perspective on how agentic workloads and AI-native applications are reshaping database usage patterns.
Deep developer empathy, for both internal engineering teams and our customers, and the technical depth to make sound architectural tradeoffs in collaboration with engineering.
A track record of taking ambiguous, high-stakes reliability and infrastructure problems and turning them into clear strategy and shipped outcomes.
Strong communication and storytelling skills.

sections.title: What would be nice to have but not required
paras: If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.
bullets: Experience as a database engineer, DBA, or infrastructure engineer.
Hands-on experience with Postgres internals, replication tooling, or the extension ecosystem (e.g., pgvector, PostGIS).
Experience building AI agents or the data infrastructure that powers them.

ashby:stedi:4461fc91-b44d-4718-8b55-1d86.summary:
Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.

sections.title: We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse
paras: To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote . To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital .

sections.title: What we are looking for
paras: We’re growing our Solutions Engineering team. Our customers are building on a clearinghouse, which means their first months with Stedi are a technical project: mapping their use case to our APIs, testing submissions and reading what comes back, and getting to production volume without surprises. How well that goes decides whether a customer ever realizes the value they bought.

As a Solutions Engineer, you will be the technical counterpart to our sales and account management teams, ensuring that they have everything they need to make customers successful with Stedi. You'll work with customers from their first integration call through to running full production volume. You’ll also build the demos, guides and internal documentation that empowers the rest of customer-facing team to answer technical questions without you, and you’ll be the conduit back to Product when the answer is “we don’t do that yet”. The work moves fast, spans a lot of surface area, and has a real impact - on our customers, our revenue, and our roadmap.

sections.title: Who you are
bullets: You are technical. You understand and have experience using and integrating APIs, and have a familiarity with data formats and standards such as JSON, X12, and other flat file formats.

You are proactive by default . You don't wait for a ticket. You decide which customers need attention and when, usually before they ask, based on what you can see in their data and where they are in their ramp.

You have a product mindset. You go beyond helping customers with the task at hand. You are able to intuitively understand product gaps and are able to articulate those to the engineering and product teams, and ensure those requirements satisfy the customer's needs.

You have subject matter expertise in revenue cycle management or are excited to learn. Bonus points if you have experience working at an RCM company and understand the full cycle of how healthcare technology companies run eligibility checks, submit claims, check claim status, and reconcile ERAs.
You do what it takes to get the job done. You are resourceful, self-motivating, self-disciplined, and don’t wait to be told what to do. You put in the hours.
You are exceptional at staying on top of many open threads simultaneously. You are hyper-responsive, organized, and thorough.

Technical & Business Acumen
• You understand that real-time event streaming and agentic AI are strategic enablers for businesses, driving efficiency, responsiveness, and competitive differentiation.

Customer-Centric Mindset

Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

sections.title: JOB SUMMARY
paras: Apptronik's most important audiences — the executives, customers, investors, and partners who will define how the world sees Apollo — encounter our technology through live demonstrations. This role is responsible for making those moments exceptional.

As Senior Application Engineer, Customer Experience , you will own the full lifecycle of Apollo demonstrations at our California office and at events worldwide. You will design, build, and operate the robot behaviors and workcell environments that bring Apollo to life for VIP visitors — applying the same engineering discipline, rigor, and process we use for every customer field deployment.

Operating as the senior technical presence at our California satellite office, you will work with significant autonomy, represent Apptronik's engineering capability to our most critical audiences, and serve as a direct feedback channel between what customers experience and what our product teams build. This is a high-visibility, high-impact engineering role at the intersection of robotics, customer engagement, and product storytelling.

sections.title: Requirements & Strategy
bullets: Stakeholder alignment — Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success leadership to define objectives, success criteria, and technical scope for each high-priority visit; capture the agreed storyline and constraints in a concise brief that aligns all internal stakeholders before execution begins.

Technical scoping authority — Serve as the definitive technical voice on Apollo's demonstrable capabilities — providing honest, confident assessments of what can be shown credibly and reliably to any given audience, and shaping stakeholder expectations accordingly.

Audience-driven design — Translate visit objectives into scenario designs that reflect real customer problems and workflows, ensuring every demonstration is grounded in the customer's world, not just the robot's capabilities.

sections.title: Design & Architecture
bullets: Solution architecture — Design demonstration scenarios with the same structured approach used in customer field deployments: clear requirements, defined success criteria, risk assessment, and a documented architecture that can be handed off and reproduced.

Fallback and risk design — Define comprehensive fallback architectures and failure-mode mitigation strategies that protect demonstration integrity under live conditions — anticipating failure paths before they occur and building recovery into the run-of-show by design.

Simulation-driven development — Build and maintain demonstration-specific simulation environments using tools such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or MuJoCo to validate and optimize robot behaviors before live deployment, reducing integration risk and rehearsal time.

sections.title: Build & Integration
bullets: Application development — Develop, configure, and tune the demo applications and robot behaviors required for each scenario, reusing production-grade software where possible and building purpose-built variants where needed — maintaining code quality and documentation standards throughout.

Workcell ownership — Build and own the Apollo demonstration environment at the California office — including hardware configuration and staging — ensuring the environment meets both technical requirements and the experiential standards expected by VIP visitors.

Hardening and readiness — Drive demonstration readiness through rigorous rehearsal, systematic testing, and issue tracking; identify hardware and software problems early and maintain accountability for their resolution with the relevant engineering teams.

You will own the judgment call of which asset-evaluation and diligence analyses have generalization potential across the AAD team's sourcing and evaluation work, and what form that generalization should take: sometimes a landscape analysis (the same method run not on one gene, but on every gene, surfaced as a standing analysis that informs sourcing rather than a product), sometimes a fully engineered, scaled tool built in partnership with Data Science and Engineering. You are the connective tissue between one-off diligence work and durable diligence and sourcing capability.

This is a hybrid science and product role on AAD. You will set technical and product direction for a working team of data scientists and engineers who continue to report to their functional leads. You'll need enough technical depth to judge when a diligence method holds up at scale, and enough product judgment to know when “scale” means a single exhaustive analysis rather than a maintained tool - all in service of how Formation sources and evaluates drug assets.

Guide the technical approach on methods being scaled, including statistical validity at exhaustive scale, pipeline design, and dataset evaluation. You need enough technical judgment to know when an approach is sound and when to push back.

Work with scientific and technical teams to identify any new opportunities for AI to impact Formation’s asset acquisition and diligence process and be able to pitch those to stakeholders with a clear explanation of resourcing and business impact.

sections.title: Product Owner Overview:
paras: At Incident IQ, we are reinventing how software gets built. In our Full Stack Agentic Development (FSAD) model, engineering capacity is no longer the bottleneck, context is. The Product Owner is the person who eliminates that bottleneck. This role is less about managing a backlog and more about becoming the deepest source of customer understanding on the team, translating real K–12 pain points into the structured context that AI agents and developers need to build the right thing, fast.

This means spending less time in traditional Agile ceremonies and more time inside the build cycle, co-creating in real time alongside developers and AI agents, validating output as it is generated, and ensuring the team never loses the “why” behind what they are building. The right candidate brings deep empathy for K–12 customers, the precision to encode that understanding into markdown-based Vision Canvases, and the drive to prove that Human + AI + Dev produces more than the sum of their parts.
Technical background matters less than attitude. We are looking for someone who:
bullets: Sees AI as a collaborator, not just a tool, and is excited to plan and work inside AI environments alongside their team.
Is energized by building new processes, not just following established ones.
Can execute with discipline in the present while imagining and influencing a better future model.
Communicates with precision, knowing that clear inputs to AI systems are as important as clear requirements to engineers.
Thrives in a fast-moving, iterative environment where today’s best practice may be replaced by something better next quarter.

sections.title: Product Owner Responsibilities:
bullets: Develop deep, firsthand empathy for K–12 customer workflows, becoming the team’s ultimate source of truth on what users need, why they need it, and what “winning” looks like for them.

Transform customer pain points into high-fidelity Vision Canvases, structured markdown documents that provide the shared context AI agents and developers need to build the right thing without rework or misinterpretation.

Be present and active inside the build cycle, participating in real-time alongside developers and AI agents, validating code and UI/UX as it is generated rather than reviewing it days later in a handoff.
Participate in lightweight team cadences focused on outcomes and unblocking, not ceremony. Agile rituals serve the work; the work does not serve the rituals.

Design for the customer, not for the process, collaborating with designers and engineers to ensure every UX decision is grounded in real user workflows and validated quickly, not debated in planning docs.
Work closely with Customer Success to identify, triage, and resolve key product issues.
Support go-to-market initiatives and product launches with internal enablement and external communication.
Own and continuously sharpen the team’s shared context, ensuring every member of the pod, human and AI, understands the “why” behind every feature well enough to make good decisions independently.

paras: As a Staff Product Manager at Roo, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving company-wide impact by leading high-priority initiatives that map directly to our most critical business goals.

You'll partner with a cross-functional team spanning engineering, design, data, marketing, and sales to define how veterinary professionals discover Roo, get to work, and build durable careers on the platform.

As the lead product driver in this BU, you’ll be a strategic thought partner to the GM and drive definition of and execute against a product strategy that delivers measurable outcomes against the BUs goals. Operating with significant autonomy, you’ll take a growth-minded, iterative approach by identifying leverage points, shipping improvements quickly, and building scalable systems for our customers and internal users.

bullets: Own the path from sign-up to first shift which includes identity and license verification, the approval decision, first-run experience, and the flow from browsing to requesting to working. Decide what gets automated and what stays human.

Turn promotions and incentives from operator-run levers into product such as targeting, automation and guardrails that decide where a dollar goes.
Partner with the BU's growth marketer as a pair, not a handoff: shared conversion targets, joint experiments, and a standing argument about where the bottleneck actually is.
Fix the instrumentation before the roadmap. Work with the BU analyst on cohort definitions, attribution and holdouts so we ship what we can prove.
Co-own the BU strategy with the GM to help decide what we do and don't do, carry the product half, and say out loud when a committed lever isn't working.
Keep one marketplace. Your decisions land on hospital screens too; partner with the PMs in the other BUs so users get one product, not our org chart.

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

sections.title: Our mission
paras: Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

sections.title: How you'll help us achieve it
paras: Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can’t, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn’t take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale.

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don’t know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be.

AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren’t secure, won’t scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt.

sections.title: In this role, you'll...
bullets: Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way.

Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward.

sections.title: Key Details
bullets: This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso
Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy.

Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per quarter. Exceptions apply, but we’ve found this key to understanding our users and product.
Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary up to $237,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.

lever:supermove:0f318ca9-3c7b-4350-ab02-.summary:
Supermove builds software and AI for moving companies. We've raised $30M from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and other investors. We started in 2019 as the system that runs a moving business: sales, operations, crews, billing. Today that system runs moving companies across the US, Canada and Australia, from single-location movers to some of the largest van lines and franchise systems in North America.

Now we're putting AI to work on top of it. Our voice agents answer and call leads, book moves, and hand off to a person at the right moment. Autopilot, our agent platform, goes further. It answers questions about the business in plain language, flags what needs attention, and handles work that used to take a person's whole day, from working the inbox to updating jobs.

sections.title: The role
paras: When a major account signs with us, someone has to make sure it delivers. It goes live on time, it hits the results the customer bought us for, and it renews bigger than it started. That's you.

Enterprise moving is complicated work. A large account can mean hundreds of locations, franchisees or agents with their own ways of doing things, several systems that need to talk to each other, and a leadership team that expects results in months, not years. Getting AI to work inside an operation like that is the hard part. We want someone who enjoys that problem.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Own the relationship and the results for a small number of our largest accounts, from the executive sponsor to the ops leads who use Supermove every day.
Run implementations as real projects: discovery, scope, plan, milestones, go-live. Keep the teams moving and hold them to their dates, including people who don't report to you.
Plan and lead onsite working sessions. Get the right people in the room and leave with decisions made.
Design how AI fits into each customer's operation. Decide which calls a voice agent should take, which workflows Autopilot should run, and where a person still belongs in the loop.
Stay hands-on with the agents once they're live. Review calls and agent sessions, find where things break down, tune the playbooks, and measure again.

Be the customer's voice inside Supermove as Autopilot grows. Our largest customers will be among the first to push it into new parts of their business, and what you learn with them will shape what we build next. Turn it into clear, prioritized input for product and engineering.
Prove ROI with data. Know what we're generating for each account before they ask, and build the dashboard or analysis that shows it.
See risk early and act on it. Work with sales before the handoff so what we sold is what we deliver, and drive expansion once the account is healthy.

sections.title: What we're looking for
bullets: 4+ years in management consulting, enterprise implementation, solutions or technical account management, or a similar client-facing role where you owned complex projects end to end.
You've run programs with many stakeholders and moving parts, and you can walk us through how you kept one on track.

You're technical enough to go deep. You understand APIs, webhooks, and data flows, and you're at home with engineers. You can read an integration spec and tell us what's missing. SQL or light scripting is a plus. Production code is not required.

You use AI seriously in your own work. Ideally you've built, tuned, or evaluated an LLM-based agent or workflow, and you have a view on what makes one trustworthy enough to run a real business process.
You're credible with a CEO or COO and just as useful with a dispatcher. When the answer isn't the one a customer hoped for, you give it straight and keep their trust.
You write clearly. A lot of this job happens in writing.
Moving, logistics, or field-services experience is a plus. We'll teach you the industry.

sections.title: Why this role matters
paras: Our largest accounts are where AI in this industry gets proven, one real operation at a time. How well they go shapes our product, our reputation, and our growth. You'll work directly with our CEO and leadership team, and you'll help decide how Supermove runs enterprise accounts from here on.

You will own the commercial growth, strategic development, and long-term health of an assigned portfolio of clients, turning established relationships into broader, more valuable partnerships.

This is a highly consultative, commercially driven role for professionals who are as curious about solving business problems as they are motivated to grow revenue. You will immerse yourself in your clients’ businesses, understand the pressures and opportunities shaping their industries, and proactively identify where Toptal can make a meaningful difference. Rather than waiting for clients to tell you what they need, you will bring ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and work with our experts to shape solutions that address both immediate priorities and longer-term strategic objectives.

We are looking for individuals who combine the commercial drive of a business developer, the problem-solving mindset of a consultant, and the relationship skills of a trusted advisor. You should be energized by uncovering opportunities within complex organizations, expanding into new business units, building executive relationships, and converting ideas into meaningful commercial engagements. At Toptal, we believe our potential is defined by the problems we can solve and the outcomes we can deliver for our clients. With capabilities spanning technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent, we have the opportunity to take on increasingly complex and meaningful business challenges. Realizing that potential requires people who think beyond the immediate ask, challenge conventional approaches, and bring the initiative and judgment to turn ideas into results.

You will own the commercial strategy and growth of assigned enterprise client relationships, serving as a strategic partner who understands each client’s business, identifies emerging needs, and proactively develops opportunities to deliver greater value. You will work across client organizations to uncover challenges, shape solutions, and expand Toptal’s role in helping clients achieve their objectives.

This is not a passive account management role. This role combines strategic business development, creative problem-solving, and consultative selling to address client needs across both linear, OTT, and digital platforms, including high-profile “tentpole” events.

sections.title: Job Description
bullets: Meet and exceed revenue goals by effectively selling the NBC Local/KBLR Telemundo, Peacock/OTT, digital solutions, and special event sponsorships (e.g., Olympics, NFL Sunday Night Football, NBA, MLB, World Cup).
Drive new business while maintaining meaningful relationships with existing clients.

Leverage a consultative approach by understanding each client’s marketing objectives and developing customized proposals that align with our full suite of advertising products (on-air, digital, streaming, and experiential).
Collaborate with internal teams (sales management, marketing, creative, and support) to craft relevant, high-impact campaigns and deliver measurable results.
Proactively prospect through cold calls, networking, and outreach, while maintaining accurate and timely documentation in tools such as Salesforce.
Entertain and engage clients to nurture lasting partnerships, which may include attendance at non-business hour events.
Stay informed about market trends, competitive landscapes, and research data (e.g., Nielsen, Wide Orbit, and more) to refine sales strategies and proposals.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience
Minimum 5 years of experience in media sales and/or marketing roles with a successful track record of generating increased sales
Knowledge of media research and measurement products
Proven success selling non-linear AD solutions including OTT/CTV

Excellent computer skills with MS programs: Excel, PPT, Word and ability to create innovative presentation decks with expertise

Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in United States

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. smartrecruiters:servicenow:7440001553195.summary:
The Martech team enables Marketing to scale through connected platforms, reliable data, automated processes, and technology solutions that support lead management, CRM processes, campaign execution, reporting, and revenue growth.

As a Data Product Manager, Marketing Technology, you will define and deliver Martech capabilities with an initial focus on owning end-to-end lead flow, lead validation and enriching processes, Marketing data integrations, and platform optimizations and consolidations. You will partner across Marketing, IT, Digital, and Data teams to translate business needs into clear requirements, prioritize enhancements, and drive scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.

sections.title: What you get to do in this role:
bullets: Act as the data product owner and advocate for Marketing stakeholders, gathering feedback, identifying pain points, and translating needs into Martech capabilities and enhancements.

Develop, own, and manage clear business requirements for Martech initiatives, including lead management, lead processing analysis and reporting, system integrations, data quality enhancements, and operational workflows.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to understand Martech platform capabilities, system roadmaps, integration dependencies, customization needs, and implementation processes.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle, including roadmap planning, discovery, requirements definition, sprint planning, product reviews, testing, launch readiness, and post-launch optimization.
Identify, prioritize, and document business requirements, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
Prepare current-state and future-state process documentation, system workflows, training materials, and gap analyses to support business alignment and change management.
Define and track desired outcomes, OKRs, KPIs, and adoption metrics to measure the success of Martech initiatives.
Lead or support stakeholder alignment, including obtaining cross-functional sign-off on requirements, solution design, UAT readiness, and release decisions.

sections.title: Qualifications
paras: For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $116,400 - $192,100 , plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.
bullets: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Technology, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in product management, business product management, marketing technology, marketing operations, CRM, marketing automation, or a related function.
Proven experience partnering with Marketing, Sales, IT, Data, and other cross-functional teams to design, deliver, and continuously improve marketing technology solutions.
Strong experience with Marketing automation systems and data platforms
Experience working with Martech integrations, third-party tools, data flows, APIs, lead management processes, campaign operations, or customer data platforms.

The Customer Success Executive—US Manufacturing is a senior individual contributor role within the Customer Excellence Group (CEG), responsible for driving customer outcomes, retention, and expansion across a portfolio of high-value US Manufacturing accounts. This role carries full accountability for the commercial health and strategic growth of assigned accounts—operating with the ownership mentality of a general manager at the account level.

This is not an account-monitoring role. We are looking for a commercially minded operator who has personally driven demonstrable YoY growth within a large portfolio, built trusted executive relationships, and executed cross-functional motions that convert platform adoption into measurable business outcomes. You will serve as the primary post-sales customer executive for your accounts—a strategic advisor to manufacturing CIOs and senior IT…

sections.title: Job Description
paras: • Own account-level commercial performance. Drive GRR, NRR, and renewal outcomes for your assigned accounts through proactive risk management, downsell prevention, and expansion motions.

• Engage at the executive level as a strategic advisor. Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite and senior IT stakeholders. Co-develop digital transformation strategies with customer executives, positioning ServiceNow as the strategic platform partner for their modernization and AI agendas. Bring relevant industry thought leadership and a consulting mindset to every engagement. Your executive presence and credibility at this level must be a proven strength, not an aspiration.

• Translate customer strategy into a ServiceNow roadmap. Take each customer’s enterprise priorities—modernization, cost-out mandates, AI ambitions—and map them to a phased ServiceNow roadmap that connects platform capabilities to measurable business outcomes. You bridge the gap between what the C-suite wants to achieve and how the platform gets them there.

sections.title: Qualifications
paras: The ideal candidate will have extensive experience leading large-scale digital business transformations, acting as a trusted advisor to both internal and C-level customer executives. You combine deep post-sales expertise with the executive presence to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with manufacturing CIOs and a bias toward action that turns customer outcomes into revenue outcomes. You will be an expert in governance, strategy, value alignment, and execution across cross-functional teams, with a track record of delivering scalable, repeatable success. Your passion for driving customer success at an enterprise scale and your ability to work in complex, dynamic environments will be key to your success in this role.
To be successful in this role, you will need

• AI driven. Experience leveraging or critically evaluating how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
